scope: Whole A02 aircraft plus full-width representative three-story facade band: first nose contact only, intact elastic diagnostic. No prescribed penetration, rupture or historical outcome.

units.solver: g mm ms MPa N Nmm

aircraft.loading: A01 nominal 122159.1859781 kg: hypothetical fuel/payload/engine/unresolved empty mass. A02 native CG/inertia retained without compensating fit.
aircraft.nose_alignment: Central column and central spandrel height; own direct-hit test, not inferred AA11 location.
aircraft.contact_nodes: Vertices of external skins/caps only. Exclude mass reference nodes, internal ribs/spars and engine center points.
aircraft.known_limit: Aluminum nose closure inherited as intact hypothesis, not a composite radome construction; engine cylinders are visual and do not supply contact surfaces. No physical rupture or crushing law.

facade.material_origin: Static constants from v8v_openradioss_deformable_projectile.json; its plasticity, strain rate and failure values are not transferred.
facade.source_origin: Cached NIST NCSTAR1-6C nominal 59 columns/face,14in width,40in pitch,52in spandrel; 12ft story and nearby thicknesses from prior representative V8V/I02A. Not an exact impact-floor plate schedule or corner reconstruction.
facade.construction: Closed square shell columns, front spandrel strips, merged nodes at boundaries; perfect joints. No floor slab, core, corner columns, gravity prestress, splice failure or tower compliance.
facade.boundary: All translations and rotations fixed only at upper/lower column ends; idealized band supports, not whole-tower response.
facade.frame: Previous facade (lateral x, vertical y, depth z) becomes aircraft (X=z-50,Y=x,Z=y), a proper cyclic rotation. Plane X=-50mm faces aircraft moving -X.

contact.type: TYPE7 external aircraft nodes to facade shell surface
contact.gap_origin: Declared numerical thickness envelope close to half of 2.54mm skin + 7.9375mm plate; not calibrated to damage

elastic_diagnostics.classification: Static typical yield references and geometric strain monitors only; exceeding them marks elastic extrapolation, does not delete an element or trigger calibrated fracture. Bending outer-fiber yield not fully bounded by midplane stress.

sources: work/official_sources/ncstar1-6c.pdf (cached source identity; no full reread)
